name: B10-0464/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission delegated regulation of 8 July 2025 supplementing Directive (EU) 2024/1788 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying a methodology for assessing greenhouse gas emissions savings from low-carbon fuels
part_text:
The European Parliament is blocking a European Commission rule on how to measure the climate benefits of low-carbon hydrogen. The Parliament says the rule is too strict and too complicated. It argues the rule would make low-carbon hydrogen almost impossible to produce in Europe, especially in countries that rely on nuclear power. The Parliament wants the Commission to write a new, simpler rule by late 2026.

- **What changes:** The Commission's rule cannot enter into force. A new rule is requested by late 2026.
- **Who it affects:** Hydrogen producers, energy-intensive industries, and countries using nuclear power.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must propose a new rule; Parliament wants simpler emission rules and nuclear power counted.
